title: His 1951 band and the Pax record date with Helen Ward
summary: He names the band's changing players, then recounts playing Philadelphia, driving to New York for the Paradox date with Helen Ward, and driving back to play again.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Oh, I don't remember; I had so many changes.
Ephy Resnick on trombone.
Yes, I was picking guys up all the time.
Charlie Treger--
Charlie Traeger and the drummer I'm going to play with tomorrow night---
Eddie Phyfe.
Eddie Phyfe, yeah.
And, the piano player was Dean---
Dyberry--
Dyberry.
A very good piano player.
Now, didn't that band one time you had a job in Philadelphia and you had a record date in New York---
Yes, I did. Came to New York and made the date and went back and played that night.
And Helen Ward on vocal.
Yeah - that's right.
Did you want to tell that story?
Well, that's all there is to it.
Okay but that's one of your best records, a lot of people think.
Yeah - it was a long time ago.
Made under extreme conditions but you got some songs under there that are just absolutely tremendous.

Well, I thought Helen Ward was just marvelous because she hadn't sang in a long time and that's the first time I really found out about Helen Ward. She happen to be at the record date and when I went with our instruments in and we all piled in there -- she was playing some beautiful
piano and singing; I never knew she played the piano. First time I knew that.
What you guys did - is you played a job in Philadelphia and then drove to New York--
Yeah.
---had the record date and drove back to Philadelphia and played the job again.
Of course - that was the only way we could do it.
Yeah - but, you made some great music with no sleep, no (inaudible) - no nothing.
Yeah - that's right but I remember that record date; it was on Pax. (Ed.- the Paradox label.)
Yeah.
Pax label--- and it was quite a time. I think we made that for a guy named Harry Lim--
Harry Lim---
I think financed that one. And, it was a long time before it came out and when I heard it - I was very delighted with it, you know, it was well done.
It certainly was.
Yeah.
It's an outstanding record.
